title: Dreamy Cinematic Storyboard
subtitle: 25-panel fantasy mood board for a vertical short-video sequence

panels.label: Dream space
panels.caption: Establish the world with instant atmosphere.
panels.prompt: wide establishing shot, moonlit reflective hall, haze, same protagonist

panels.label: Slow entry
panels.caption: Let the protagonist enter softly into frame.
panels.prompt: subject entering through haze, flowing dress, ethereal pace

panels.label: Reveal through veil
panels.caption: Use fabric or haze to partially conceal and reveal.
panels.prompt: veil reveal, dreamy lighting, same face identity

panels.label: Floating close-up
panels.caption: Move closer while keeping the atmosphere soft.
panels.prompt: close portrait, floating camera feeling, halo rim light

panels.label: Hand and particles
panels.caption: Show tactile interaction with light or particles.
panels.prompt: hand moving through glowing particles, gentle motion

panels.label: Fabric drift
panels.caption: Let fabric carry the motion of the shot.
panels.prompt: translucent fabric drifting, same protagonist, same hall

panels.label: Reflective surface
panels.caption: Use a mirror, glass, or water reflection.
panels.prompt: reflection shot, mirrored highlights, elegant composition

panels.label: Side portrait
panels.caption: Profile view with soft emotional depth.
panels.prompt: side portrait, dreamy expression, same identity, haze

panels.label: Glow low-angle
panels.caption: Make the character feel lifted and iconic.
panels.prompt: low-angle glow shot, shimmering dress, halo light

panels.label: Mirror double
panels.caption: Create a subtle double image or mirrored echo.
panels.prompt: mirror double, surreal but elegant, same protagonist

panels.label: Walk through veil
panels.caption: Move slowly through a soft foreground element.
panels.prompt: walking through translucent veil, layered depth

panels.label: Breathing pause
panels.caption: A calm moment before the emotional rise.
panels.prompt: medium shot, stillness, inhale moment, same atmosphere

panels.label: Eye close-up
panels.caption: Make the gaze a story beat.
panels.prompt: close-up on eyes, reflective light, intimate emotion

panels.label: Macro detail
panels.caption: Use water, dew, glass, or jewelry detail as punctuation.
panels.prompt: macro dream detail, dew or glass sparkle, poetic insert

panels.label: Wide release
panels.caption: Expand the space for the emotional peak.
panels.prompt: wide emotional release, full-body, floating energy

panels.label: Turning away
panels.caption: Let the figure turn away to create longing.
panels.prompt: turning away, soft hair motion, reflective floor

panels.label: Over shoulder
panels.caption: Look back without breaking the dreamy tone.
panels.prompt: over-shoulder look back, same protagonist, same dress

panels.label: Foreground veil
panels.caption: Use something soft in the foreground for depth.
panels.prompt: foreground obstruction, soft bloom, layered composition

panels.label: Halo portrait
panels.caption: Make the light itself feel like a character.
panels.prompt: halo portrait, radiant backlight, dreamy glamour

panels.label: Drifting medium
panels.caption: Let the camera feel like it is gliding.
panels.prompt: drifting medium shot, elegant movement, same hall

panels.label: Reach gesture
panels.caption: Reach into the space as if crossing worlds.
panels.prompt: reaching gesture, lyrical pose, soft particles

panels.label: Environment reaction
panels.caption: Let light or particles answer the motion.
panels.prompt: environment reacts to motion, sparkles or ripple glow

panels.label: Surreal hero
panels.caption: One full-body hero frame with strongest fantasy tone.
panels.prompt: surreal full-body hero, moonlit reflective hall, same protagonist

panels.label: Fade stillness
panels.caption: Hold one calm beat before exiting.
panels.prompt: still medium-wide frame, quiet emotion, haze and glow

panels.label: Exit dissolve
panels.caption: End on a frame that feels like a dissolve or dream exit.
panels.prompt: exit frame, gentle dissolve feeling, same protagonist, same hall
